Dinamo Moskva vs Krasnodar Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Dinamo Moskva welcome Krasnodar to the VTB Arena in Moscow on 22 November 2026 for a Russian Premier League fixture scheduled to kick off at 11:00 GMT. The match pits the league's second-placed side against the fourth-placed team, with both clubs firmly in the hunt for Champions League qualification. Dinamo enter the game on a strong run of form, having won four of their last five league matches, while Krasnodar have collected seven points from their last five outings. With only five points separating the two sides in the table, the result could have a significant impact on the top-four race.

A win would keep them in the title conversation and maintain pressure at the summit. Krasnodar occupy fourth place with 26 points from 14 games, five points behind Dinamo but only two points clear of fifth-placed CSKA Moskva. Victory for the visitors would close the gap to the top two and strengthen their Champions League qualification bid, while a defeat could see them drop out of the top four depending on other results. Both teams have shown strong home form this season, making this a pivotal fixture in the race for European places.

After 14 matches, Dinamo Moskva have recorded 10 wins, 1 draw and 3 losses. They have scored 23 goals (1.64 per game) and conceded 13 (0.93 per game). The team has kept six clean sheets this season and boasts the second-best defensive record in the division behind Zenit.
